'''Mateusz Gamrot''' (born December 11, 1990) is a Polish professional [[mixed martial arts|mixed martial artist]]. He currently competes in the [[Lightweight (MMA)|Lightweight]] division of the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] (UFC). Gamrot is a former [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Featherweight championship|KSW Featherweight Champion]] and [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Lightweight championship|KSW Lightweight Champion]]. As of 10 August 2026, he is #9 in the [[Meta Platforms|Meta]] [[UFC rankings#Lightweight|UFC lightweight rankings]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=UFC Rankings, Division Rankings, P4P rankings, UFC Champions {{!}} UFC.com |url=https://www.ufc.com/rankings |access-date=2026-06-20|website=www.ufc.com}}</ref>

==Background==
Gamrot started wrestling at the age of ten.<ref name=unf22 /> At middle school age, he moved to a boarding school in [[Milicz]] to train in freestyle wrestling. While studying in a technical school, he was part of the national wrestling team where he won medals in the Polish junior and youth championships. As a 20-year-old he permanently relocated to [[Poznań]], where he trains and has a wife and two children.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-10-16|title=Gamrot: Pas UFC będzie spełnieniem marzeń|url=https://www.przegladsportowy.pl/sporty-walki/mma/mateusz-gamrot-pas-ufc-bedzie-spelnieniem-marzen/mpmh4z0|access-date=2021-07-12|website=Przegląd Sportowy|language=pl}}</ref>

He began his wrestling career in 2002, achieving success at the national and international level. He competed in over 300 matches including ones at the European and World Championships. He transitioned to mixed martial arts in 2011, training under, Andrzej Kościelski, World Champion in wrestling.<ref>{{Cite web|title=O Mnie {{!}} Mateusz Gamrot|date=15 March 2017 |url=http://www.mgamrot.pl/omnie/|access-date=2021-07-12|language=pl}}</ref>

In 2012, he won a gold medal in the 70&nbsp;kg category of the European Amateur MMA Championships (Brussels), defending his title the following year (Budapest).<ref name="gloswielkopolski_794900">{{Cite web|last=Redakcja|date=2013-03-29|title=Mateusz Gamrot z Poznania obronił tytuł mistrza Europy w MMA na zawodach w Budapeszcie|url=https://gloswielkopolski.pl/mateusz-gamrot-z-poznania-obronil-tytul-mistrza-europy-w-mma-na-zawodach-w-budapeszcie/ar/794900?cookie=1|access-date=2021-07-12|website=Głos Wielkopolski|language=pl}}</ref>

He won the gold medal at the Polish grappling championships in the purple belt category (Luboń) in 2013 and 2014. In 2014 he won the [[ADCC Submission Fighting World Championship#ADCC European Championship|ADCC Submission Wrestling European championships]] in the 77&nbsp;kg category.<ref name="gloswielkopolski_794900"/>

==Mixed martial arts career==
=== Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki ===
He made his professional MMA debut on February 4, 2012, at XFS Night of Champions, defeating Chechen Arbi Shamayev. By the end of the year he had won two more fights for the federation and signed with [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki|KSW]]. On June 8, 2013, he had his first fight in KSW, beating Mateusz Zawadzki via TKO at [[2013 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 23: Khalidov vs. Manhoef|KSW 23: Khalidov vs. Manhoef]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Bijan|first=Jakub|date=2013-06-08|title=KSW 23 - wyniki oraz relacja z gali|url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ksw/ksw-23-wyniki-na-zywo|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMA Rocks!|language=pl}}</ref> On September 28 at [[2013 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 24: Clash of the Giants|KSW 24]] he defeated former UFC fighter [[Andre Winner]] by unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Chmura|first=Tomasz|date=2013-09-28|title=KSW 24: Starcie gigantów - wyniki i relacja na żywo|url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/pawel-nastula/ksw-24-starcie-gigantow-wyniki-i-relacja-na-zywo|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMA Rocks!|language=pl}}</ref> At [[2014 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 27: Cage Time|KSW 27]], Mateusz defeated Jefferson George on points.<ref>{{Cite web|last=_Logan_|date=2014-05-17|title=KSW 27: Cage Time - wyniki i relacja|url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mamed-khalidov/ksw-27-cage-time-wyniki-na-zywo|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMA Rocks!|language=pl}}</ref>

On September 13, 2014, he made his promotional debut for Cage Warriors, defeating Welshman Tim Newman in the 1st round with a heel hook submission at CW 72.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2014/09/cage-warriors-72-results-tauru-submits-tait-to-capture-vacant-bantamweight-title|title=Cage Warriors 72 results: Tauru submits Tait to capture vacant bantamweight title|date=September 13, 2014|work=[[MMAjunkie.com]]|author=Mike Bohn}}</ref> He returned to KSW on December 6, 2014, to defeat Łukasz Chlewicki at [[2014 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 29: Reload|KSW 29]] via unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Bijan|first=Jakub|date=2014-12-06|title=KSW 29 - wyniki, relacja oraz paczka wywiadów po gali|url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ksw/ksw-29-wyniki-na-zywo|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMA Rocks!|language=pl}}</ref> At [[2015 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 30: Genesis|KSW 30]] on February 21, 2015, he defeated Brazilian Rodrigo Cavalheiro Correia by technical knockout six seconds before the final bell.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Bijan|first=Jakub|date=2015-02-21|title=KSW 30: Genesis - wyniki, relacja oraz punktowanie redakcji|url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ksw/ksw-30-genesis-wyniki-relacja-oraz-punktowanie-na-zywo|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMA Rocks!|language=pl}}</ref> Gamrot earned a Knockout of the Night bonus for his performance.<ref name=ksw30b />

At [[2015 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 32: Road to Wembley|KSW 32: Road to Wembley]], Mateusz defeated Marif Piraev via TKO in the second round, improving his record to 10-0.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Bijan|first=Jakub|date=2015-11-01|title=Wyniki KSW 32 - wyniki i relacja z Wembley Arena|url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ksw/ksw-32-wyniki-na-zywo-z-londynu|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMA Rocks!|language=pl}}</ref>

====KSW Lightweight Championship====
On May 27, 2016, at [[2016 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 35: Khalidov vs. Karaoglu|KSW 35]], he fought for the vacant [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Lightweight championship|KSW Lightweight Championship]] belt against former British BAMMA and Russian M-1 Global champion Frenchman [[Mansour Barnaoui]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Mansour-Barnaoui-Mateusz-Gamrot-to-Vie-for-Vacant-Lightweight-Title-at-KSW-35-103663|title=Mansour Barnaoui, Mateusz Gamrot to Vie for Vacant Lightweight Title at KSW 35|date=April 20, 2016|work=[[Sherdog]]|author=Tristen Critchfield}}</ref> He won the title via unanimous decision. Both fighters were awarded the Fight of the Night bonus.<ref name="KSW01">{{Cite web|date=2016-05-27|title=Wyniki KSW 35 – na żywo w MMAnews od godziny 20:00|url=https://www.mmanews.pl/2016/05/wyniki-ksw-35-na-zywo-w-mmanews-od-godziny-1900/|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMANews|language=pl}}</ref><ref name=ksw35b />

At [[2016 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 36: Materla vs. Palhares|KSW 36: Materla vs. Palhares]] on October 1, 2016, he defended his title via heel hook against Renato Gomes Gabriel in the second round.<ref name="KSW02">{{Cite web|title=KSW 36: Materla znokautował Palharesa! Gamrot i Narkun obronili pasy - Polsat Sport|url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2016-10-01/ksw-36-relacja-na-zywo/|access-date=2021-07-12|website=polsatsport.pl|date=October 2016 |language=pl}}</ref>

Gamrot faced former UFC fighter [[Norman Parke]] at [[2017 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 39: Colosseum|KSW 39: Colosseum]] on May 27, 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/KSW-Confirms-Mateusz-GamrotNorman-Parke-LW-Title-Bout-5-Title-Fights-Set-for-Colosseum-119247|title=KSW Confirms Mateusz Gamrot-Norman Parke LW Title Bout; 5 Title Fights Set for 'Colosseum'|date=March 26, 2017|work=[[Sherdog]]|author=Jordan Breen}}</ref> He won the bout and retained the title via unanimous decision.<ref name="KSW03">{{Cite web|title=KSW 39: Wyniki gali na Stadionie Narodowym - Polsat Sport|url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2017-05-27/ksw-39-relacja-i-wyniki-na-zywo-khalidov-pudzianowski-popek-burneika/|access-date=2021-07-12|website=www.polsatsport.pl|date=27 May 2017 |language=pl}}</ref>

Gamrot rematched [[Norman Parke]] at [[2017 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 40: Dublin|KSW 40: Dublin]] on October 22, 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Mateusz-GamrotNorman-Parke-Lightweight-Title-Rematch-Added-to-Oct-22-KSW-40-in-Dublin-125635|title=Mateusz Gamrot-Norman Parke Lightweight Title Rematch Added to Oct. 22 KSW 40 in Dublin|date=July 31, 2017|work=[[Sherdog]]|author=Jordan Breen}}</ref> At the weigh-ins, Parke came in one pound over the championship limit and the bout was declared a non-title bout.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mmaweekly.com/one-fighter-removed-from-ksw-40-main-event-and-a-title-fight-gets-demoted|title=	One Fighter Removed from KSW 40 Main Event and a Title Fight Gets Demoted|date=October 21, 2017|publisher=mmaweekly.com}}</ref> The bout was stopped in the second round when accidental eye pokes left Parke unable to continue. Following this Parke shoved Gamrot's cornerman, Borys Mankowski, which resulted in Marcin Bilman, another professional fighter who was in the champion's corner, punching Parke. Gamrot was subsequently fined 30% of his purse and Bilman was handed a two-year ban from KSW events.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Team|first=The42|title=Parke punched by opponent's cornerman after controversial ending to Dublin bout|url=https://www.the42.ie/ksw-40-review-3660333-Oct2017/|access-date=2021-07-12|website=The42|date=23 October 2017 }}</ref>

On March 3, 2018, at [[2018 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 42: Khalidov vs. Narkun|KSW 42: Khalidov vs. Narkun]], Gamrot defeated Grzegorz Szulakowski via keylock submission in the fourth round, defending the KSW Lightweight Championship.<ref name="KSW04">{{Cite web|date=2018-03-03|title=KSW 42: Mateusz Gamrot nadal niepokonany i nadal mistrzowski, pokaz MMA w wykonaniu Polaka|url=https://sport.onet.pl/mma/ksw/ksw-42-mateusz-gamrot-grzegorz-szulakowskki-zobacz-wynik-walki/0lsk86m|access-date=2021-07-12|website=Onet Sport|language=pl|archive-date=2022-11-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221108044818/https://sport.onet.pl/mma/ksw/ksw-42-mateusz-gamrot-grzegorz-szulakowskki-zobacz-wynik-walki/0lsk86m|url-status=dead}}</ref>

====Two-division champion====
On December 1, 2018, at [[2018 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 46: Narkun vs. Khalidov 2|KSW 46: Narkun vs. Khalidov 2]], he fought for a second belt, this time for the [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Featherweight championship|KSW Featherweight Championship]], against submission specialist [[Kleber Koike Erbst]], where he won the bout after a five-round domination, capturing the organization's second crown.<ref name="KSWFW1">{{Cite web|last=Kłosiński|first=Łukasz|date=2018-12-01|title=KSW 46: Mateusz Gamrot mistrzem dwóch kategorii wagowych KSW!|url=https://inthecage.pl/ksw-46-mateusz-gamrot-mistrzem-dwoch-kategorii-wagowych-ksw/|access-date=2021-07-12|website=InTheCage.pl|language=pl}}</ref>

====Vacating the titles====
On May 17, 2019, in a video on Borys Mankowski's YouTube channel, Gamrot announced that he had vacated his two belts and did not renew his contract with KSW.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Madej|first=Jakub|date=2019-05-17|title=Szokująca decyzja! Mateusz Gamrot zwakował pasy i nie przedłużył kontraktu z KSW!|url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mateusz-gamrot/szokujaca-decyzja-mateusz-gamrot-zwakowal-pasy-i-nie-przedluzyl-kontraktu-z-ksw|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMA Rocks!|language=pl}}</ref>

On March 6, 2020, KSW announced Gamrot's return to the organization. The KSW double champion was scheduled to return at [[2020 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 53: Reborn|KSW 53]] in Łódź, Poland against the Brazilian Edimilson Souza,<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-03-06|title=Mateusz Gamrot wraca do klatki na KSW 53 w Łodzi|url=https://mmabnb.pl/mateusz-gamrot-wraca-do-klatki-na-ksw-53-w-lodzi/|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMA - BĄDŹ NA BIEŻĄCO|language=pl}}</ref> but due to the coronavirus pandemic the event was canceled.<ref>{{Cite web|title=KSW53 - Odwołane|url=http://www.kswmma.com/news/3192|access-date=2021-07-12|website=www.kswmma.com|language=pl}}</ref> On July 11 he fought his third bout at [[2020 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 53: Reborn|KSW 53: Reborn]] against [[Norman Parke]]. Parke missed weight for the bout and was fined, which went to Gamrot.<ref>{{Cite web|title=KSW 53 Weigh-in Results: Headliner Changed to Non-Title Fight After Parke Comes in Heavy|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/KSW-53-Weighin-Results-Headliner-Changed-to-NonTitle-Fight-After-Parke-Comes-in-Heavy-173884|access-date=2021-07-12|website=Sherdog}}</ref> Gamrot won the fight in the third round via technical knockout.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Media|first=Wirtualna Polska|date=2020-07-11|title=MMA. KSW 53. Mateusz Gamrot - Norman Parke 3. "Stormin" porozbijany. Polak wygrywa przed czasem! - WP SportoweFakty|url=https://sportowefakty.wp.pl/mma/890241/mma-ksw-53-mateusz-gamrot-norman-parke-3-stormin-porozbijany-polak-wygrywa-przed|access-date=2021-07-12|website=sportowefakty.wp.pl|language=pl}}</ref>

On August 29, 2020, he fought for the last time under his KSW contract against Marian Ziółkowski at [[2020 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 54: Gamrot vs. Ziółkowski|KSW 54: Gamrot vs. Ziółkowski]], who replaced the injured Shamil Musayev.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Shamil-Musaev-Out-Marian-Ziolkowski-Steps-Up-to-Face-Mateusz-Gamrot-at-KSW-54-174768|title=Shamil Musaev Out, Marian Ziolkowski Steps Up to Face Mateusz Gamrot at KSW 54|date=August 25, 2020|work=[[Sherdog]]|author=Tudor Leonte}}</ref> After a 5-round bout, Gamrot won via unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Media|first=Wirtualna Polska|date=2020-08-29|title=MMA. KSW 54. Mateusz Gamrot - Marian Ziółkowski. "Gamer" zatańczył po raz ostatni. Obronił pas - WP SportoweFakty|url=https://sportowefakty.wp.pl/mma/897311/mma-ksw-54-mateusz-gamrot-marian-ziolkowski-gamer-zatanczyl-po-raz-ostatni-obron|access-date=2021-07-12|website=sportowefakty.wp.pl|language=pl}}</ref>

===Ultimate Fighting Championship===
====2020====
On September 17, 2020, it was announced that Gamrot signed with the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-09-17|title=Mateusz Gamrot nowym nabytkiem UFC!! Debiut na październikowej gali|url=https://mmabnb.pl/mateusz-gamrot-nowym-nabytkiem-ufc/|access-date=2021-07-12|website=MMA - BĄDŹ NA BIEŻĄCO|language=pl}}</ref>

Gamrot, as a replacement for [[Renato Moicano]], was scheduled to face [[Magomed Mustafaev]] at [[UFC Fight Night: Ortega vs. The Korean Zombie]] on October 18, 2020.<ref name="Gamrot">{{cite web|author=Steve Duncan|date=2020-09-16|title=Moicano out, Mateusz Gamrot faces Magomed Mustafaev in the October 17 event|url=http://mma.uno/moicano-fuera-mateusz-gamrot-enfrenta-a-magomed-mustafaev-el-evento-del-17-de-octubre/|access-date=2020-09-17|publisher=mma.uno|archive-date=2020-09-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200919122701/http://mma.uno/moicano-fuera-mateusz-gamrot-enfrenta-a-magomed-mustafaev-el-evento-del-17-de-octubre/|url-status=dead}} {{in lang|es}}</ref> In turn, Mustafaev pulled out in early October due to undisclosed reasons.<ref name="VOout">{{cite web|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2020-10-01|title=Canceled four fights for various UFC events in Abu Dhabi|url=https://mmadna.nl/vier-gevechten-gecanceld-voor-verschillende-ufc-evenementen-in-abu-dhabi/|access-date=2022-07-25|publisher=mmadna.nl}} {{in lang|nl}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|author=Maciej Święch|date=2020-10-02|title=Mateusz Gamrot is waiting for the winner: I've fired the hardest part of it if it all happened|url=https://mma.pl/fen-30-wyniki-wazenia/|access-date=2020-10-04|publisher=mma.pl}} {{in lang|pl}}</ref> Gamrot faced fellow promotional newcomer [[Guram Kutateladze (fighter)|Guram Kutateladze]] instead.<ref name="new">{{cite web|author=Jamal Boussenaf|date=2020-10-06|title=Guram Kutateladze replaces Magomed Mustafaev against Mateusz Gamrot|url=https://mmadna.nl/guram-kutateladze-vervangt-magomed-mustafaev-tegen-mateusz-gamrot/|access-date=2022-07-25|publisher=mmadna.nl}} {{in lang|nl}}</ref> He lost the close fight via split decision.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Media|first=Wirtualna Polska|date=2020-10-18|title=MMA. UFC Abu Zabi. Mateusz Gamrot - Guram Kutateladze. Sensacja! Polak przegrał w debiucie - WP SportoweFakty|url=https://sportowefakty.wp.pl/mma/905364/mma-ufc-abu-zabi-mateusz-gamrot-guram-kutateladze-sensacja-polak-przegral-w-debi|access-date=2021-07-12|website=sportowefakty.wp.pl|language=pl}}</ref> Both fighters earned the ''[[List of UFC bonus award recipients|Fight of the Night]]'' award.<ref name="UFN180">{{Cite web|author=Ryan Galloway|date=2020-10-17|title=UFC Fight Island 6 bonuses|url=https://www.lowkickmma.com/ufc-fight-island-6-bonuses/|access-date=2020-10-17|publisher=lowkickmma.com}}</ref>

====2021====
Gamrot faced [[Scott Holtzman]] on April 10, 2021, at [[UFC on ABC: Vettori vs. Holland]].<ref>{{Cite web|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2021-02-27|title=Scott Holtzman treft Mateusz Gamrot tijdens UFC evenement op 10 april|url=https://mmadna.nl/scott-holtzman-treft-mateusz-gamrot-tijdens-ufc-evenement-op-10-april/|access-date=2022-07-25|website=MMA DNA|language=nl}}</ref> He won the fight via knockout in the second round.<ref name="Gamrot def. Holtzman">{{cite web|last=Anderson|first=Jay|date=10 April 2021|title=UFC Vegas 23 Results: Mateusz Gamrot Gets First UFC Win in Style, KO's Scott Holtzman|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2021/04/10/ufc-vegas-23-results-scott-holtzman-vs-mateusz-gamrot/|access-date=10 April 2021|website=Cageside Press}}</ref> This win earned him the [[List of UFC bonus award recipients|''Performance of the Night'']] award.<ref name="UFConABC2">{{cite web|author=Staff|date=2021-04-10|title=UFC on ABC 2 bonuses: Mackenzie Dern's armbar finish earns her $50,000|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/lists/ufc-on-abc-2-bonuses-mackenzie-derns-armbar-finish-earns-her-50000|access-date=2021-04-10|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com}}</ref>

Gamrot faced [[Jeremy Stephens]] on July 17, 2021, at [[UFC on ESPN: Makhachev vs. Moisés]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-05-13|title=Jeremy Stephens meets Mateusz Gamrot at UFC Fight Night on July 17|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2021/05/jeremy-stephens-vs-mateusz-gamrot-ufc-fight-night-july-17-mma-booking-matchup|access-date=2021-05-13|website=MMA Junkie}}</ref> He won the fight via [[Armlock|kimura]] in round one, this submission is the quickest of its kind in UFC history.<ref name="Fight-Facts-UFC-on-ESPN-26-180612">{{cite web | url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/articles/Fight-Facts-UFC-on-ESPN-26-180612 | title=Fight Facts: UFC on ESPN 26 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Vreeland|first=Daniel|date=2021-07-17|title=UFC Vegas 31 Results: Mateusz Gamrot Kimuras Jeremy Stephens in Quick Fashion|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2021/07/17/ufc-vegas-31-results-mateusz-gamrot-kimuras-jeremy-stephens-quick-fashion/|access-date=2021-07-18|website=Cageside Press}}</ref> This win earned him the'' [[List of UFC bonus award recipients|Performance of the Night]]'' award.<ref name="UFC on ESPN 26">{{Cite web|date=2021-07-18|title=UFC on ESPN 26 bonuses: Miesha Tate gets extra $50,000 in return from retirement|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/lists/ufc-on-espn-26-bonuses-miesha-tate-return-from-retirement-50000|access-date=2021-07-18|website=MMA Junkie}}</ref>

As the first bout of his new four-fight contract, Gamrot faced [[Carlos Diego Ferreira]] on December 18, 2021, at [[UFC Fight Night 199|UFC Fight Night: Lewis vs. Daukaus]].<ref>{{Cite web|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2021-11-10|title=UFC's jaarafsluiter krijgt Lightweight knaller tussen Carlos Diego Ferreira en Mateusz Gamrot|url=https://mmadna.nl/ufcs-jaarafsluiter-krijgt-lightweight-knaller-tussen-carlos-diego-ferreira-en-mateusz-gamrot/|access-date=2022-07-25|website=MMA DNA|language=nl}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://strefamma.pl/mateusz-gamrot-o-nowym-kontrakcie-z-ufc-nie-poszedlem-tam-po-hajs-jak-bede-wygrywal-sami-beda-placic/|title=Mateusz Gamrot o nowym kontrakcie z UFC: "Nie poszedłem tam po hajs. Jak będę wygrywał, sami będą płacić"|date=December 27, 2021|website=strefamma.pl|language=pl}}</ref> He won the bout via TKO in round two, forcing Ferreira to submit with a knee to the body.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Law|first=Eddie|date=2021-12-18|title=UFC Vegas 45: Mateusz Gamrot stops Diego Ferreira With Knee To Ribs|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2021/12/18/ufc-vegas-45-mateusz-gamrot-stops-ferreira-knee-ribs/|access-date=2021-12-19|website=Cageside Press}}</ref>

====2022====
Gamrot faced [[Arman Tsarukyan]] on June 25, 2022,  at [[UFC on ESPN 38]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-05-05 |title=Nieoficjalnie: Mateusz Gamrot zmierzy się z Armanem Tsarukyanem pod koniec czerwca! |url=https://mma.pl/nieoficjalnie-mateusz-gamrot-zmierzy-sie-z-armanem-tsarukyanem-pod-koniec-czerwca/ |access-date=2022-05-07 |website=MMA PL |language=pl}}</ref> He won the closely contested fight via unanimous decision.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2022/06/ufc-on-espn-38-mateusz-gamrot-earns-unanimous-decision-over-arman-tsarukyan | title=UFC on ESPN 38 results: Mateusz Gamrot emerges victorious in high-paced battle against Arman Tsarukyan | date=26 June 2022 }}</ref> 15 of 22 MMA media outlets scored the bout in favor of Tsarukyan.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://mmadecisions.com/decision/13299/Mateusz-Gamrot-vs-Arman-Tsarukyan|title=Gamrot def. Tsarukyan|work=MMADecisions.com|access-date=June 26, 2022}}</ref> Both fighters earned the ''[[List of UFC bonus award recipients|Fight of the Night]]'' award.<ref name="UFCESPN38">{{cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/2022/6/26/23182827/ufc-vegas-57-post-fight-bonus-winners-results-espn-mma-tsarukyan-gamrot-shavkat-rakhmonov-moises|title=UFC Vegas 57 bonuses: Shavkat Rakhmonov leads $50K winners with buzzer-beater submission|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Dan Hiergesell|date=2022-06-26|access-date=2022-06-26}}</ref>

As the first fight of his four-fight contract, Gamrot faced [[Beneil Dariush]] on October 22, 2022, at [[UFC 280]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Al-Shatti |first=Shaun |date=2022-07-20 |title=Beneil Dariush vs. Mateusz Gamrot set for UFC 280 |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2022/7/20/23272250/beneil-dariush-vs-matuesz-gamrot-set-for-ufc-280 |access-date=2022-07-24 |website=MMA Fighting}}</ref><ref name=unf22>{{cite podcast|url=https://podcasts.google.com/feed/aHR0cHM6Ly9mZWVkcy5zaW1wbGVjYXN0LmNvbS9fRG40Vmo1Ug/episode/MmI5NzYxNjAtZjVhZC00MWU1LTg4OTQtNjhjNTVhNTU5N2Y4|title=Mateusz Gamrot & AJ Dobson talk UFC 280 matchups, Jack Osbourne's jiu-jitsu journey|date=October 20, 2022|host=[[Jim Norton (comedian)|Jim Norton]]|host2=[[Matt Serra]]}}</ref> He lost the fight by unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Martin |first=Damon |date=2022-10-22 |title= UFC 280 results: Beneil Dariush drops Mateusz Gamrot late, secures unanimous decision victory|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2022/10/22/23418034/ufc-280-results-beneil-dariush-drops-mateusz-gamrot-late-secures-unanimous-decision-victory |access-date=2022-10-22 |website=MMA Fighting}}</ref>

====2023====
Gamrot, replacing [[Dan Hooker]], faced [[Jalin Turner]] on March 4, 2023, at [[UFC 285]].<ref name="Gamrot in">{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloodyelbow.com/2023/2/14/23599963/ufc-285-mateus-gamrot-replaces-dan-hooker-injury-fight-jalin-turner-mma-news|title=Report: Mateusz Gamrot replaces Dan Hooker, fights Jalin Turner at UFC 285|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Zane Simon|date=2023-02-14|access-date=2023-02-14|archive-date=2023-02-15|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230215005157/https://www.bloodyelbow.com/2023/2/14/23599963/ufc-285-mateus-gamrot-replaces-dan-hooker-injury-fight-jalin-turner-mma-news|url-status=dead}}</ref> In a closely contested bout where Gamrot employed his wrestling to combat Turner’s reach advantage, he won the bout via split decision.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Rush |first1=Dylan |title=UFC 285: Mateusz Gamrot's Wrestling Carries Him Past Jalin Turner |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2023/03/04/ufc-285-mateusz-gamrot-vs-jalin-turner/ |website=Cageside Press |access-date=5 March 2023 |date=4 March 2023}}</ref>

Gamrot faced [[Rafael Fiziev]] on September 23, 2023, at [[UFC Fight Night 228]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mma/story/_/id/38082744/ufc-fi.nalizing-rafael-fiziev-mateusz-gamrot-sept-23|title=UFC finalizing Rafael Fiziev-Mateusz Gamrot for Sept. 23|date=July 27, 2023|work=[[ESPN]]|author=Brett Okamoto}}</ref> He won the fight via technical knockout due to knee injury in round two.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Anderson |first=Jay |date=2023-09-23 |title=Rafael Fiziev Knee Injury Ends UFC Vegas 79 Main Event Early, Mateusz Gamrot Awarded TKO Victory |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2023/09/23/ufc-vegas-79-rafael-fiziev-vs-mateusz-gamrot/ |access-date=2023-09-24 |website=Cageside Press}}</ref>

In October 2023, Gamrot served as the backup fighter for the main event of [[UFC 294]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Rogers |first1=Kian |title=Mateusz Gamrot To Serve As Backup For Charles Oliveira v Islam Makhachev 2 |url=https://jitsmagazine.com/mateusz-gamrot-to-serve-as-backup-for-charles-oliveira-v-islam-makhachev-2/ |website=Jitsmagazine |date=9 October 2023 |access-date=10 October 2023}}</ref>

==== 2024 ====
Gamrot faced [[Rafael dos Anjos]] on March 9, 2024, at [[UFC 299]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Martin |first=Damon |date=2023-12-12 |title=Mateusz Gamrot vs. Rafael dos Anjos among new fights added to UFC 299 |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2023/12/12/23998975/mateusz-gamrot-vs-rafael-dos-anjos-among-new-fights-added-to-ufc-299 |access-date=2023-12-13 |website=MMA Fighting}}</ref> He won the bout by unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Law |first=Eddie |date=2024-03-10 |title=Mateusz Gamrot Earns Tough Decision Victory Over RDA |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2024/03/09/mateusz-gamrot-earns-tough-decision-victory-over-rda/ |access-date=2024-03-10 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}</ref>

Gamrot faced [[Dan Hooker]] on August 17, 2024 at [[UFC 305]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2024/07/ufc-305-dan-hooker-vs-mateusz-gamrot-perth-australia-mma-fight-booking-matchup|title=Dan Hooker vs. Mateusz Gamrot in the works for UFC 305 in Perth|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Farah Hannoun|date=2024-07-12|access-date=2024-07-12}}</ref> He lost the fight by split decision.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2024/08/17/ufc-305-thrilling-battle-propels-dan-hooker-over-mateusz-gamrot/|title=UFC 305: Thrilling Battle Propels Dan Hooker Past Mateusz Gamrot|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Val Dewar|date=2024-08-17|access-date=2024-08-18}}</ref> 9 out of 16 media outlets scored the bout for Gamrot.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://mmadecisions.com/decision/14940/Dan-Hooker-vs-Mateusz-Gamrot|title=MMA Decisions - Dan Hooker defeats Mateusz Gamrot|publisher=mmadecisions.com|author=MMA Decisions|date=2024-08-18|access-date=2024-08-18}}</ref> This fight earned him another ''[[List of UFC bonus award recipients|Fight of the Night]]'' award.<ref name="UFC305">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/2024/8/18/24222404/official-post-fight-bonus-winners-ufc-305-results-espn-ppv-du-plessis-adesanya-perth-kara-france|title=Bonuses! Kai Kara-France's stunning TKO finish leads $50K winners - UFC 305|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Dan Hiergesell|date=2024-08-18|access-date=2024-08-18}}</ref>

====2025====
Gamrot was reportedly going to face [[Rafael Fiziev]] in a rematch on February 1, 2025 at [[UFC Fight Night 250]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/2024/12/12/24319942/report-mateusz-gamrot-and-rafael-fiziev-run-it-back-at-ufc-saudi-arabia-in-2025|title=Report: Mateusz Gamrot and Rafael Fiziev run it back at UFC Saudi Arabia in 2025|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Alexander Behunin|date=2024-12-12|access-date=2024-12-12|archive-date=2024-12-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241216091046/https://www.mmamania.com/2024/12/12/24319942/report-mateusz-gamrot-and-rafael-fiziev-run-it-back-at-ufc-saudi-arabia-in-2025|url-status=dead}}</ref> However, the bout was never officially scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/brianmazique/2025/01/24/ufc-legend-and-future-hall-of-famer-has-signed-with-new-promotion/|title=UFC Legend And Future Hall-Of-Famer Has Signed With New Promotion|publisher=forbes.com|author=Brian Mazique|date=2025-01-24|access-date=2025-01-24}}</ref>

Gamrot faced [[Ľudovít Klein]] on May 31, 2025, at [[UFC on ESPN 68]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Stachura |first=Bartłomiej |date=2025-04-24 |title=Mateusz Gamrot wystąpi na majowej gali UFC Vegas! Polski lekki skrzyżuje rękawice z Ludovitem Kleinem! 
|url=https://www.lowking.pl/mateusz-gamrot-zmierzy-sie-z-ludovitem-kleinem-znamy-date/ |access-date=2025-04-24 |website=Lowking.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref> He won the fight by unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2025/05/31/ufc-vegas-107-mateusz-gamrot-dominates-ludovit-klein/|title=UFC Vegas 107: Mateusz Gamrot Dominates L'udovit Klein|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Brett Cagle|date=2025-05-31|access-date=2025-05-31}}</ref>

Replacing [[Rafael Fiziev]] on short notice, Gamrot faced former [[UFC Lightweight Champion]] [[Charles Oliveira]] on October 11, 2025 in the main event of [[UFC Fight Night 261]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bohn |first=Mike |date=2025-09-23 |title=Charles Oliveira gets Mateusz Gamrot as new UFC Fight Night 261 main event opponent |url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2025/09/23/charles-oliveira-meets-mateusz-gamrot-new-ufc-rio-de-janeiro-main-event/86316435007/ |access-date=2025-09-23 |website=MMA Junkie |language=en}}</ref> Gamrot lost the fight via a face crank submission in the second round, resulting in his first defeat by finish.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2025/10/11/charles-oliveira-submits-gamrot-in-vintage-do-bronx-fashion-calls-for-holloway-bmf-fight/|title=Charles Oliveira Submits Gamrot in Vintage Do Bronx Fashion, Calls For Holloway BMF Fight|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Eddie Law|date=2025-10-11|access-date=2025-10-11}}</ref>

====2026====
Gamrot faced [[Esteban Ribovics]] on April 11, 2026, at [[UFC 327]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/02/27/ufc-327-beneil-dariush-vs-manuel-torres-mateusz-gamrot-esteban-ribovics/88906018007/|title=UFC 327 adds two key lightweight bouts|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-02-27|access-date=2026-04-12}}</ref> He won the fight via an arm-triangle choke submission in the second round.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2026/04/11/mateusz-gamrot-dominate-finished-ribovics-calls-out-diego-lopes/|title=Mateusz Gamrot dominate, finished Ribovics, calls out Diego Lopes|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Eddie Law|date=2026-04-11|access-date=2026-04-12}}</ref>

Gamrot faced [[Quillan Salkilld]] in the main event on August 8, 2026 at [[UFC Fight Night 284]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/australian-sensation-quillan-salkilld-main-event/|title=Australian sensation Quillan Salkilld gets first UFC main event|author=Marcel Dorff|publisher=Heavy.com|date=2026-07-02|access-date=2026-07-03}}</ref> He lost the fight via a rear-naked choke submission in the first round.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2026/08/08/ufc-vegas-120-quillan-salkilld-shocks-with-submission-of-mateusz-gamrot/|title=UFC Vegas 120: Quillan Salkilld shocks with submission of Mateusz Gamrot|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Jay Anderson|date=2026-08-08|access-date=2026-08-09}}</ref>
